svg.text: Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
• The order's status follows its dishes (confirmed → preparing → ready), and Handed over completes it. The
counter's status board (24) is the customer's ready notice; a QR customer's phone receipt doesn't update by
• Any signed-in Staff or Admin can use the kitchen display. A dish only moves forward: Pending → In Progress →
• Kitchen tickets print only on the device with the kitchen printer (print-service/), once per order; if printing
fails the display says so and tries again with the next update or within 30 seconds.
